name: Segawa Ayane
source:
Daughter of Kaede. A so-called tsundere 
She is a hard worker and confident person, and is a well-rounded type who performs well in sports and studies.
When people are in trouble, she tries to help them even though she is a bit of a nag.
Unlike her mother, she has a dream to be a working woman, but she is not good at housework and secretly admires and respects her mother.
